title: Intaka Eflayo
author: Lumni
content:
# Intaka Eflayo

Kudala, kwakusehlane elikhulu, kwakukho intaka enkulu eyayiflayo ngaphezu kwawo onke amahlathi. Intaka le yayibizwa ngokuba yiNkosi Yezulu.

Ngenye imini, intaka yona ibonakalisa ubukhulu bayo. Yaqala ukubhala phantsi ngamaphiko ayo amakhulu, yenza umoya omkhulu owawuphambanisa zonke izinto ezisesikhaleni.

"Yho!" kwala umthi omkhulu. "Ungabi nangxolo, Nkosi Yezulu! Wena unqoba wonke umoya, kodwa mna ndiyimithi emile ngaphantsi kwembewu."

Intaka yamangaliswa. Yaphinda yabuza: "Kodwa ngawo amaphiko am, ndinamandla ngaphezu kwakho konke!"

Umthi waphendula: "Amaphiko akho amkhulu, kodwa ndimile phantsi kwembewu. Ndimi xa umoya uvuka, ndimila xa ilanga liba. Awunakho ukundiphambanisa."

Intaka yaqonda. Yaqonda ukuthi amandla ayengenawo yonke into. Umthi wayenesibindi esingakhuphi moya.

## Amehluko

Le stori ifundisa:

1. **Ukuzithemba** — Intaka yayizithemba ngamaphiko ayo, kodwa umthi wayenesibindi esingakhuphi moya.

2. **Ukubukeka komumo** — Intaka yaqonda ukuthi ayinawo onke amandla.

3. **Ukuhlakanipha** — Umthi wafundisa intaka ngokuzithemba nokunqoba.
